== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|"This sturdy adventuring suit glows with Mist energy. When you wear it inside Obsidian Sanctum, sometimes you catch yourself longing for a forbidden reunion."}}

== Acquisition ==
=== Sold by ===
* In order to be able to purchase the {{rarity|ascended|ascended}} piece, the equivalent [[Triumphant Hero's armor]] [[Triumphant Hero's Shinplates|piece]] must have been unlocked. Additionally, a [[WvW Rank#World ranks|WvW ranking]] of 500 is required.
{{Sold by|id = 81422}}

{{Contained in}}

=== Recipe ===
* Crafting the {{rarity|legendary|legendary}} version of this armor piece requires the {{rarity|ascended|ascended}} version be used in the following recipe:

}}
